answer: Every identity leaves a repeated echo: a deterministic behavioral signature derived from its generation history, so the same agent always sounds the same. The network pays a copper stake at admission, which is slashed if the identity splits. All active identities are then projected onto a nebula of fingerprints, where clones from one attacker collapse into a single dense cloud. Because the copper is real and non-recoverable on split, growing a nebula of fake identities means forfeiting copper for each one, making the sybil cost linear and steep.
